question: What alternative structural forms are permitted up to the entablature or above it?
premises: The structure may be solid up to the entablature.
An alternative is allowed above that point.
The alternative above may be a verandah.
inference: Either a solid form up to the entablature or a verandah above it is permitted.
plain_english: It may be solid up to the entablature, or alternatively there may be a verandah above that.
